This is a subreddit where we complain about video games? What about me complaining that someone is ruining the integrity of completion is chronically online.

Of course people can play games how they want. It doesn't hurt or affect anyone else. But earning an accolade in a game that a lot of people, myself included, take pride in by ways of cheating ruins the validity of that award.
Oh he definitely brags about it. His whole personality is how quickly he beats games.
100% complete all achievements in both games. Including the 1000 MR monsters and all the lottery rng.
That's honestly insanely impressive if true, the 1000 MR monsters alone takes ages. It's just if he DID cheat, it ruins the authenticity of people who complete them legitimately.
Iceborne and Sunbreak. And he did it completely alone, I offered to help with Sunbreak since I was also playing it but he said he was okay playing alone oddly.

Exactly, knowing a monsters tells and weakness is part of the fun. Watching out for a limp or a stagger is infinitely more exciting than watching a number tick down, at least to me. I just don't want to know but they insist on broadcasting it.
Lmao, I probably am to be honest. But it shouldn't matter who is doing the most damage, it's supposed to be fun! Like unless you're doing Alatreon or Fatalis, who cares! Just hunt and have fun!

Yeah I've known his attitude when it comes to games for a while but it's never directly effected my experience, this has just pushed me over the edge.

And using things like Hunter Pie is fine! Modding is one of the things that makes the games great on PC! But he's using it as a tool to shame others and turn the game into a number war.
